summary: Iteration 34 — Quest Play feature validated on backend, web, and mobile. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed (GET quest, GET actions, POST action w/ persistence + AI response, non-accepted 403, completed 403, lightweight character projection on /my-quests/accepted). Web: Enter Scene navigation from /my-quests, action submit + AI response, persistence across reload, completed banner, not-accepted notice — all working. Mobile (Expo web preview): quest detail Enter Scene button, quest-play-screen, Playing as banner, action submit + persistence, completed read-only bar — all working. Parity verified: web and mobile behave consistently against the shared backend.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props warning surfaced in console during login screen render. Not blocking, but should migrate to 'boxShadow'. Reference: browser console warnings on /login.

action_items: (Low priority, non-blocking) Migrate remaining React Native 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' to silence deprecation warnings on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: quests.py contains a duplicate POST /quests/{quest_id}/participants/{acceptance_id}/complete handler (a '_legacy' variant at ~line 184 and the active one at ~line 301). FastAPI registers the last one, so behaviour is correct, but the legacy function is dead code and should be removed to reduce confusion.

The POST /api/quests/{quest_id}/actions endpoint's 'turn_number = len(action_history)' is not safe under concurrent submissions (two simultaneous posts would receive the same turn_number). Not observed in this test but worth a monotonic counter or index constraint.
QuestPlay web page polls /actions every 12s via setInterval — fine, but not currently paused when the tab is backgrounded. Minor efficiency nit.
seed_data_creation: None — used the provided pre-seeded quests (201107e7…, 30976291…, and dynamically discovered an unaccepted open quest for the not-accepted case).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quest Play feature (web + mobile) is functional end-to-end. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_quest_play.py. The lightweight character projection on /api/quests/my-quests/accepted is verified (< 200KB payload cap in test; portrait_url absent). If retesting after further changes, note that submitting a real action calls the AI Quest Master which takes ~5-15s (image-generation batch is currently stopped per the task note; do NOT restart it).
